raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The bar chart displays the negative log probability values for various medical specialties, with the x-axis representing per-specialty terms—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics—and the y-axis showing negative log probability on a linear scale ranging from -22 to -27. Each specialty has a group of bars corresponding to different fine-tuned models, as indicated by the legend: Mistralv0.2-Base (light blue), Cardio (light orange), Gastro (medium orange), Infect (dark orange), Neuro (brown), Obstetrics (dark brown), and Pediatrics (very dark brown). The bars within each group are arranged horizontally, with the Mistralv0.2-Base model consistently showing the lowest negative log probability (highest value) across all specialties. The remaining bars, representing the specialty-specific fine-tuned models, are generally higher (worse) in negative log probability compared to the base model. The bars are sorted by specialty along the x-axis in the order listed, and no additional visual emphasis such as shading or annotations is present.
